Sophie (People Ops): FYI Max (contractor) asked for a 2-week extension — original end 2024-07-31 -> proposed 2024-08-14. Need to align on access sunset, asset return, final invoice, and whether we need any benefit/COBRA steps.
Alejandro (Eng Manager): +1 to extension, helpful for finishing the shard-migration. No COBRA for contractors AFAIK.
Jordan (IT): Noted. Can we get final day and last commit/hand-off doc? I'll prepare the deprovision checklist. Items off the top of my head: Okta disable, GitHub org remove, GCP service account key rotation, S3 access revoke, Databricks token revoke, badge/door access disable, laptop wipe & return.
Max (Contractor): Thanks — I can stay through 8/14. I'll put a handover doc in Google Drive tonight (link when ready). I'll also cut my final invoice for the week ending 8/9 and another for 8/14.
it-deploy-bot: Reminder: automated offboarding windows run weekly on Thursdays at 09:00 PT. Manual requests accepted, but schedule may shift.
Sophie (People Ops): Quick confirmations: 1) COBRA? -> contractor = not eligible, so no COBRA paperwork. 2) Benefits/401k finalization? -> nothing to action. 3) We still need asset return logistics (laptop + dongles) and final invoice contact.
Alejandro (Eng Manager): Billing contact: finance@redwood.com for contractor invoices; cc me. We'll approve promptly. For assets, Max — can you ship the laptop to SF office return address or drop at your local office mail center? We'll reimburse shipping.
Max (Contractor): I can drop at UPS on 8/15 morning. I'll create a shipping label tonight and share tracking. Laptop model is MacBook Pro M1, company image.
Jordan (IT): Cool. For access sunset plan: proposed schedule -> disable Okta + Slack + GitHub on 2024-08-15 09:00 PT; revoke cloud keys same window; badge deactivation immediate after final badge check-in. If you need later, tell us. Also please paste the GCP service-account names that need rotating.
Sophie (People Ops): I'll add a calendar event for 2024-08-15 08:45 PT for final offboarding sync and confirm all parties.
Max (Contractor): GCP service accounts I touched: service-account-shard, ci-deploy-sa. I'll add them to the handoff doc and mark which are safe to rotate.
Jordan (IT): Perfect — once you mark them I'll run:
```
# rotate keys example
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=ci-deploy-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# update secrets and revoke old key
```
Jordan (IT): Also: please ensure no personal 2FA devices left linked to company accounts. We'll need the device IDs if so.
Sophie (People Ops): On exit interview: for contractors we do a short 15-min wrap call — optional. Max, would you be open to a quick call on your last day? :slightly_smiling_face:
Max (Contractor): Yeah I'm happy to do 15. Book me for 8/15 11:00 PT.
Alejandro (Eng Manager): I'll join for 5 mins to say thanks and capture product handover notes.
Jordan (IT): Action items recap: 1) Max -> handoff doc + shipping tracking + mark SA keys (by EOD). 2) Sophie -> calendar event + asset return instructions + confirm shipping reimbursement. 3) Jordan -> prepare deprovision run and schedule 8/15 09:00 PT; run key rotations after handoff. 4) Finance -> expect invoices w/ week breakdown; Sophie will cc finance.
Sophie (People Ops): I'll ping finance now and set reimbursement process in motion. :white_check_mark:
it-deploy-bot: Offboarding ticket #OFF-2024-0815-188765 opened for Max. Automated checklist attached.
Max (Contractor): Thanks everyone — working on the doc now, will upload link in this thread when ready.
Sophie (People Ops): Great — unless anything changes we'll proceed with the 8/14 last working day and 8/15 deprovision. Will update if plans shift. :memo:
